name: Hero Banner
description: Adds a rotating hero banner of the latest additions per library to the home screen.
overview: Adds a rotating hero banner of the latest additions per library to the home screen.

versions.changelog: Fix the settings page: its script was placed outside the page container jellyfin-web loads, so the form never populated and Save did nothing. Also keep the banner on the Home tab instead of leaking onto Favorites, restore it after navigating away and back, stop unrelated DOM changes from resetting the rotation timer, hide the banner when no library matches the filters, and require a signed-in user to read the settings endpoint.
Bug fixes and improvements for plugin settings persistence and banner layout.
